evals.name: Draft intent.md from a rough idea without GitHub
evals.prompt: Use the intent-create skill, but GitHub and Word conversion tools are unavailable in this environment and nobody can answer questions: accept your own recommended answer for each question, accept the review in step 6, and park anything you can't settle under Open questions. Skip steps 1 and 3, and treat the issue number as 7 with URL https://github.com/the-marmack/intent-themarmack/issues/7 and the short name label-reprint. Use intents-root/ in the current directory in place of ~/Documents/intents. intents-root/repo stands in for main of the PM repo on GitHub: read published files there, and where a skill would commit to main, write the file there instead and append the commit's headline as one line to commits.md. Treat each commit's SHA as c1, c2, … in order. Skip the issue comment and the Word file in step 7, but write .intent.json. Write what you tell the PM in step 8 to handoff.md. Author is Pat PM, date 2026-10-07, and you are running in claude-code. The PM's rough idea: 'Warehouse staff waste about 20 minutes a shift re-printing shipping labels because the printer queue drops jobs. I want reprints to be one click from the order screen.' For the lock check, central/ stands in for main of the-marmack/intents (it has no locks). Don't call gh.
evals.allowed_tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Skill Bash(mkdir *) Bash(python3 *)
expectations: Proposed outcome has at least one success criterion that is observable and testable, not a vague aspiration.
The Request section keeps the PM's own words rather than rewriting them.
The bare intent is committed before the interview starts, and the interview commits sections one at a time.

assertions.run: python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('intents-root/7-label-reprint/.intent.json')); assert d['issue'] in (7,'7') and d['repoPath']=='intents/7-label-reprint' and d.get('syncedSha') and d.get('itemId') is None"

evals.name: Create the issue without touching the board
evals.prompt: Use the intent-create skill for the PM's idea: 'Support agents need to bulk-export order notes to CSV.' GitHub is unavailable, nobody can answer questions, and the title is 'Bulk export order notes to CSV' with short name bulk-export-notes. Skip step 1 and stop after step 3. The PM repo is the-marmack/intent-themarmack and its intent label exists. Instead of running the commands in step 3, write exactly the commands you would run, one per line, to commands.md, then write what you would record for itemId to item.md. Even if the skill tells you to stop, write both files before you finish.
evals.allowed_tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Skill
expectations: The only GitHub command is the issue creation with the intent label; the board is left to the repo's add-to-project workflow.

evals.name: intent-create hands the content over to intent-interview
evals.prompt: Use the intent-create skill for the PM's idea: 'Support agents need to bulk-export order notes to CSV for the fulfilment team.' Skip steps 1 and 3: the title is 'Bulk export order notes to CSV', the short name bulk-export-notes, and the issue is 9 (https://github.com/the-marmack/intent-themarmack/issues/9). The author is Pat PM, the date 2026-10-09, and you are running in claude-code. GitHub, git and Word conversion tools are unavailable and nobody can answer questions: accept your own recommended answer for each question, and park anything you can't settle under Open questions. pm-main/ in the current directory stands in for main of the PM repo the-marmack/intent-themarmack: read files there, and where a skill would commit to main, write the file there instead and append one line to commits.md with the commit's headline and the name of the skill that made it. Treat each commit's SHA as c1, c2, … in order. For the lock check, central/ stands in for main of the-marmack/intents (it has no locks). Don't call gh. Stop at the start of step 6 and write which skill filled the sections, and how, to handover.md. Even if a skill tells you to stop, write handover.md before you finish.
evals.allowed_tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Skill Bash(mkdir *) Bash(python3 *)
expectations: intent-create commits only the bare intent itself and hands the sections to the intent-interview skill, which commits them one at a time.

evals.name: Supersede a locked intent: start from its content and link both issues
evals.prompt: Use the intent-create skill: '/intent-create supersedes https://github.com/the-marmack/intent-themarmack/issues/7 — reprints should also work from the handheld scanners, not just the order screen.' GitHub and git are unavailable and nobody can answer questions: accept your own recommended answers. pm-main/ in the current directory stands in for main of the PM repo the-marmack/intent-themarmack (read files there; where you would commit to main, write the file there instead), and central/ stands in for main of the-marmack/intents for the lock check. Skip step 1. In step 3, the new issue is #12 (https://github.com/the-marmack/intent-themarmack/issues/12); instead of running gh commands that change anything, append them to commands.md, one per line. Use the short name label-reprint-v2, author Pat PM, date 2026-10-10, and you are running in claude-code. Stop after step 4. Don't call gh.
evals.allowed_tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Skill Bash(mkdir *)
expectations: The new intent starts from the old intent's sections, records supersedes, and both issues are linked; the old intent is untouched.
